name: Empower Companion
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target animal companion
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Will Negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Empower companion may be cast only on your companion creature.

Your companion creature gains a +8 competence bonus to one skill selected by you. Multiple empower companion spells do not stack, but may provide bonuses to additional skills.
